Home
Welcome to Peartree House -the Bed and Breakfast that doesn't cost the earth, where sustainable tourism comes second only to the comfort of our guests. Our recently refurbished B&B is a five minute walk from the centre of the village with its restaurants, tea rooms and pubs. We offer two en-suite guest bedrooms and high quality, locally sourced, full breakfasts.
The Corstopitum Roman site is also a five minute walk. We have facilities for walkers and cyclists and are on the Hadrian's cycle route and 1.5 mile from the Hadrian's walk route.
Hexham is 4 miles away, Newcastle 18 miles and Newcastle Airport 15 miles. For wedding guests looking for comfortable accommodation we are a short taxi ride from Slaley Hall, Matfen Hall and High House Brewery.

About Us
Corbridge is a village located in Northumberland, situated 16 miles west of Newcastle and 4 miles east of Hexham (an awarding winning market town). Corbridge has a rich Roman history with Corstopitum Roman Site less than a 5 minute walk from Peartree House and a number of other fascinating sites in the area.

The nearest railway station is Corbridge, which is 1.5 km (1.0 miles) away
(a 20-30 minute walk). If you require a taxi this can be booked in advance, call Geoff on 01434 634006
The nearest bus stop is 0.8km (1/2 mile) from the B&B. Corbridge is serviced by:
685 Newcastle to Carlisle operated by Arriva
684 Newcastle to Hexham operated by Travelnortheast
No 10 Newcastle to Hexham via Metrocentre and Prudhoe operated by Gonortheast.
